name: Busa Invest (Webull)
description: Read-only Webull brokerage portfolio dashboard (accounts, positions, insights)

agentPrompts.label: Give me a portfolio overview
agentPrompts.body:
{target}

Read the `busa-invest-webull` skill in this folder and follow its workflow, then open the Overview view and summarize total market value, unrealized P/L, day change, cash, and the asset-type allocation, plus any insights flagged. This is a monitoring dashboard with no trading path — never place, modify, or cancel orders, and never move money.

agentPrompts.label: What changed in my portfolio today?
agentPrompts.body:
{target}

Read the `busa-invest-webull` skill in this folder and follow its workflow, then summarize today's day change, top movers, and any new insights (concentration, allocation drift, cash drag) surfaced since the last sync.
